restore_project_desc: Scan mounted data roots for project manifests or legacy prj_* output directories and import existing annotations without rerunning inference.
scan_root_hint: Use a specific directory such as /media/.../zmb_datas/openimg. It must be inside a mounted data root.
existing_project_image_dir_hint: Legacy outputs do not contain source metadata. Enter the image directory used when the project was created.
no_projects: No projects found. Create one to start.
model_services_hint: Manage internal inference containers. sapiens-api uses the Sapiens2-5B pose model and downloads missing assets with progress.
sapiens_enable_first: The model is not loaded or downloaded while the service is stopped.
sapiens_checkpoint_missing: Missing Sapiens2-5B pose model or detector
add_data_desc: Upload images to project directory. Filenames will be auto-renamed on collision.
drop_zone: Drop images here or click to select
settings_saved_restart_optional: Settings saved. Restart the app if you want to reload the process.
allowed_data_roots_hint: Add or remove mounted paths on the server with deploy.sh data-root add/remove. Saving settings cannot add Docker mounts.
upload_root_readonly_hint: This directory comes from the Docker mount. Add host directories on the server with deploy.sh data-root add.
upload_target_hint: Dataset uploads use this as the default target. It must be inside one mounted data root.
new_data_root_hint: Enter the host directory to mount into web-auto. A complete command will be generated below for copying into the server terminal.
upload_target_not_mounted: This path is not mounted into web-auto: {{path}}. Copy and run the command below on the server, then save again.
mount_command_hint: Copy and run this command on the server. The script adds the Docker mount, sets the default upload directory, and recreates web-auto.
copy_failed: Copy failed. Copy the command manually.
confirm_restart_web_auto: Restart web-auto now? Running background jobs will be interrupted; stop or finish them first.
restart_pending: Restart is still pending. Refresh the page later.
password_changed_login_again: Password changed. Please sign in again.
confirm_rebuild_annotation_index: Rebuild the annotation store/index? This scans JSON annotation files for all project images and imports them into SQLite. Large datasets may take a while.
dashboard_rebuild_hint: The SQLite annotation store or stats index does not cover all images yet. Rebuild it to improve annotation loading, class filtering, and dashboard data.
box_exemplar_required: Draw at least one positive exemplar box first.
box_exemplar_mode_hint: Positive exemplar mode enabled; add negative boxes to exclude confusing matches.
confirm_apply_filter: Preview results ready. Confirm apply filter/merge?
filter_preview_expired: Preview expired or params changed. Please re-preview.
cancel_task_confirm: Cancel this task? This cannot be undone.
migrate_sources_confirm: This will infer a source tag (sam3 / LA / manual) for every untagged annotation and rewrite annotation files on disk. Continue?
image_load_failed: Failed to load image or annotations
select_image_prompt: Select an image from the left to start
preview_results_desc: Select a class, draw at least one positive box, optionally add negative boxes, then find similar objects.
sam3_not_ready_hint: Stop or unload locate-anything-api and start sam3-api, then run LA Boxes to Masks again.
both_loaded_warning: Loading SAM3 and LocateAnything simultaneously may cause out-of-memory. Unload one before inferring.
locate_backend_text_only: LocateAnything backend supports text inference only, not Find Similar by Box.
export_dir_placeholder: Leave empty to use the project exports directory
export_yolo_hint: YOLO exports either boxes or masks; merged-contour annotations become one line per contour in YOLO-seg.
export_coco_hint: COCO/JSON can export boxes and masks together; annotations without contours are skipped in mask mode.
export_ready_hint: Pick a format, sources and classes, then export.
export_stats: Wrote {{anns}} annotations / {{images}} images; skipped: source {{source}}, class {{cls}}, no contour {{poly}}, no box {{bbox}}, missing image {{missing}}
export_empty_title: No annotations match the current filters
export_preview_failed: Failed to load counts; export still works
confirm_delete_project: Are you sure you want to delete this project? Data goes away, files stay.
